title: Allocate unambiguous CCP2 wire discrimination
description:
Scope: the activation and encoding sections of /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/spec/02b-ccp-receiver-aware.md, with a focused linked appendix only if the exact contract needs one. Specify the message discriminator, revision/mode representation, envelope lengths, and namespace registry separating policy, PHY, regional plan/version, generation, SFN, SCHC rule-set version, signature domain, and JSON format. Check against the adopted policy and existing dispatch allocations. Deliver a bounded discriminator table that old nodes cannot mistake for a compatible data schedule by ignoring an optional field. Do not implement codecs, enable RF modes, reopen policy, or resurrect SCHC Rule 0x08.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Extend the existing normative document or one narrowly justified appendix, not a parallel protocol. Use the closed Rule 0x08 adjudication as settled evidence. Publication verification is an engineering prerequisite, not a new approval request.
acceptance_criteria: The CCP2 specification contains exact field widths, values, length rules, and absence/unknown/incompatible-mode behavior. Hand-worked old/new advertisement classifications demonstrate that optional legacy fields cannot activate CCP2. Every namespace has a distinct definition; SCHC v3 and link-domain v1 are not repurposed. References to the already-adopted source policy resolve. This closes a wire-definition slice, not an implementation or RF-conformance claim.
